description: The bounded S001 ABC Color body read reports a public gathering at Chile corner Avda. Ygatimí in Asunción and a demand for the attorney general’s resignation or impeachment. It is truncated at the 250000-byte cap, reports no numeric turnout, and the extraction did not establish exact event onset/end. A Palace of Justice reference and the relation to S002 remain unresolved; S002 is search-only.
required_followup: In a new authorized phase, review S002 under its own fresh exact-URL gate to determine whether the EFE report describes the same or a distinct gathering and whether it supplies date/attendance evidence. If S001 date, turnout, physical end or Palace-site boundaries remain material, pursue only a fresh permitted exact-URL retrieval with a new complete gate.

description: S003 is a search-result call for a Ko’ág̃a demonstration; the result does not establish that a gathering occurred.
required_followup: In a future authorized reading phase, verify execution, date, location, organizers, demand and observed attendance from S003 and seek contemporaneous corroboration if needed.

description: S004 and S005 are search-result leads to a planned Ciudad del Este follow-up/“second mobilization.” Neither result establishes execution or whether the reports describe a distinct action.
required_followup: Verify actual execution and event boundaries, and inspect the written-origin relationship, with separate fresh access gates for any exact URL requested.

description: S006’s headline refers to a “movida” at the Directorate of Supplies, but search metadata does not tell whether a public gathering occurred. A phase04 receipt was saved, but the full manual review and body request were not completed before the phase closed; the source remains search-only and no denial is inferred.
required_followup: In a new authorized phase, complete a fresh full publisher/origin/restriction review for the exact S006 URL and request the body only after its live gate passes; determine what “movida” means and whether a gathering, date, demand and attendance are documented.

description: S009 reports a deadline for MEC action, not a gathering. S010 says a late-February FEP mobilization was planned; execution, date and site remain unknown.
required_followup: Verify the exact S010 announcement and any contemporaneous execution report under fresh gates; do not count the deadline as an event.

description: S016 and S017 point to women’s demands directed at the Ministry of Women; captured search metadata does not establish exact occurrence, date, venue, attendance or whether both items describe one action.
required_followup: Assess the strongest exact report first, then cross-check the second exact URL only if it can clarify identity, origin, attendance or state response; use separate fresh gates.

description: S018 and S019 announce a PLRA/Efraín Alegre mobilization or call. Planned size is not observed attendance, and event occurrence and political-rally eligibility are unresolved.
required_followup: Verify whether an in-month public gathering occurred, its crowd and demand, and apply the political-rally rule after reading event context; do not infer occurrence from an announcement.

description: S020 is an undated search-result lead about a Frente Mujer call. No publication date, February date or relation to another action is established.
required_followup: Keep the item unassigned to February unless a dated original report is found and reviewed under a fresh gate.

description: S012–S015 are search results about announced March 2 school actions; S021–S023 are March-protest or pandemic-governance context leads. These results do not establish a February onset or a February event continuing into March.
required_followup: Maintain February/March boundaries; review adjacent months only if source bodies establish a physical continuation or a distinct February action.

description: S001 body evidence establishes a public gathering and an own-state demand for the attorney general’s resignation or impeachment, but no numeric attendance; E001 therefore remains pending_threshold. Its exact event date, the ≥50 threshold, political-rally treatment where relevant, EFE/ABC relationship and event-specific state responses remain unresolved. For E002–E007, occurrence and eligibility also remain unverified. All seven state-response variables are unknown for every candidate; no silence is coded as no response.
required_followup: Read exact source bodies under fresh per-URL access gates; preserve unknowns unless evidence supports a field and a particular gathering.

description: The 10 captured open-web search actions include 40 exact query strings and 253 ordered headers across national, week-range, sector, education, medicine, women, labor and political leads. They are a bounded discovery surface, not an exhaustive news corpus.
required_followup: Consider additional targeted regional and archive research if warranted; do not infer event absence from this search result set.

description: Searches used primarily Spanish and English, with limited Guarani terminology, but did not systematically examine Guarani-language media, all local/regional outlets, radio/television archives or social-media archives.
required_followup: If further coverage is required, search those media in a bounded documented pass and preserve actual query/response captures.

description: LexisNexis was not searched. Open-web indexing/ranking and captured headers cannot establish completeness. S001 alone has one bounded, truncated current-unit body read; the other 22 source-card pages have not had a current-unit body read.
required_followup: Keep the dossier as an open-web first pass and compare with any authorized archive baseline when available.

description: The local May 2015 Clark–Regan codebook was reviewed and supplies the project’s public-gathering/50-person and own-state demand screening concepts; current official dataset version and any additional Coding Procedure remain unverified.
required_followup: Coordinator baseline review against the current official codebook/procedure is required before official coding.

description: S001 body evidence reports a larger group arriving by caravan near 19:30, but it does not establish the exact event date/onset or physical ending. The Palace of Justice reference may be a separate site/action, and S002’s relation to S001 is unresolved. No read evidence defines physical episode boundaries for the other February leads or establishes a February action continuing across a month boundary.
required_followup: Review adjacent-month source evidence only if fresh bodies establish exact physical dates and continuity; do not duplicate or split based on publication dates.
